art_style: approved dalle-test-v6, satin gradients and angular tech traces
tool: built-in image_gen; no CLI or external API fallback
postprocess: Grid cell extraction, 3% transparent safe padding on each side, Lanczos resize only. No semantic image manipulation.

chips.label: Hammer Time
chips.text: A little extra weight behind every swing. +2 damage.

chips.label: Hammer Down
chips.text: Now it really lands. +3 damage.

chips.label: Hammerfall
chips.text: Gravity does the rest. +4 damage.

chips.label: Bullseye
chips.text: Aim for the middle. Critical chance +8%.

chips.label: Dead Center
chips.text: Right where it hurts. Critical chance +12%.

chips.label: Perfect Shot
chips.text: You never miss. You just pick the moment. Critical chance +16%.

chips.label: Quick Draw
chips.text: Special attacks cost 1 stamina less.

chips.label: Second Wind
chips.text: Every hit gives you 1 stamina back.

chips.label: Full Flow
chips.text: Quick Draw and Second Wind in one. Just keep moving.

chips.label: Payback
chips.text: Hit me and I hit back. Counters deal x1.2.

chips.label: Backlash
chips.text: They'll regret that swing. Counters deal x1.35.

chips.label: Reversal
chips.text: Your parry turns the whole fight around. Counters deal x1.5.

chips.label: Hot Blade
chips.text: A warm edge. Every hit has a 20% chance to set the enemy on fire.

chips.label: Flame Blade
chips.text: It hisses on contact. Every hit has a 30% chance to set the enemy on fire.

chips.label: Inferno Blade
chips.text: Bring marshmallows. Every hit has a 40% chance to set the enemy on fire.

chips.label: Spark Blade
chips.text: A tingle at the tip. Every hit has a 20% chance to shock the enemy.

chips.label: Shock Blade
chips.text: Hair stands up. Not just yours. Every hit has a 30% chance to shock the enemy.

chips.label: Thunder Blade
chips.text: Zeus called. He wants his edge back. Every hit has a 40% chance to shock the enemy.

chips.label: Sharp Cut
chips.text: Just a scratch. Mostly. Every hit has a 20% chance to make the enemy bleed.

chips.label: Deep Cut
chips.text: Not a scratch. Every hit has a 30% chance to make the enemy bleed.

chips.label: Bloody Edge
chips.text: Dramatic, but effective. Every hit has a 40% chance to make the enemy bleed.

chips.label: Rattle
chips.text: Teeth rattle. Every hit has a 20% chance to shake the enemy so its armour is gone for 2 rounds.

chips.label: Quake
chips.text: The ground disagrees with them. Every hit has a 30% chance to shake the enemy so its armour is gone for 2 rounds.

chips.label: Earthshaker
chips.text: Even the floor feels it. Every hit has a 40% chance to shake the enemy so its armour is gone for 2 rounds.

chips.label: Splash
chips.text: A bit damp. Every hit has a 20% chance to soak the enemy, so parrying gets easier.

chips.label: Soak
chips.text: Thoroughly wet. Every hit has a 30% chance to soak the enemy, so parrying gets easier.

chips.label: Flood
chips.text: Someone should have brought a towel. Every hit has a 40% chance to soak the enemy, so parrying gets easier.

chips.label: Ember Shell
chips.text: Loads the barrels with fire. +1 fire damage on every shot. Only one element shell at a time.

chips.label: Flame Shell
chips.text: Loads the barrels with fire. +2 fire damage on every shot. Only one element shell at a time.

chips.label: Inferno Shell
chips.text: Loads the barrels with fire. +3 fire damage on every shot. Only one element shell at a time.

chips.label: Rain Shell
chips.text: Loads the barrels with water. +1 water damage on every shot. Only one element shell at a time.

chips.label: Tide Shell
chips.text: Loads the barrels with water. +2 water damage on every shot. Only one element shell at a time.

chips.label: Tsunami Shell
chips.text: Loads the barrels with water. +3 water damage on every shot. Only one element shell at a time.

chips.label: Stone Shell
chips.text: Loads the barrels with earth. +1 earth damage on every shot. Only one element shell at a time.

chips.label: Boulder Shell
chips.text: Loads the barrels with earth. +2 earth damage on every shot. Only one element shell at a time.

chips.label: Mountain Shell
chips.text: Loads the barrels with earth. +3 earth damage on every shot. Only one element shell at a time.

chips.label: Breeze Shell
chips.text: Loads the barrels with wind. +1 wind damage on every shot. Only one element shell at a time.

chips.label: Gust Shell
chips.text: Loads the barrels with wind. +2 wind damage on every shot. Only one element shell at a time.

chips.label: Storm Shell
chips.text: Loads the barrels with wind. +3 wind damage on every shot. Only one element shell at a time.

chips.label: Tough Coat
chips.text: A thicker lining. Protection +1.

chips.label: Iron Coat
chips.text: Heavy, but it holds. Protection +2.

chips.label: Dragon Coat
chips.text: Scales, apparently. Protection +3.

chips.label: Steady Hands
chips.text: Calm hands. Parry window +10%.

chips.label: Calm Mind
chips.text: Nothing rattles you. Parry window +15%.

chips.label: Zen Cuffs
chips.text: Breathe in. Parry. Breathe out. Parry window +20%.

chips.label: Deep Breath
chips.text: One more breath. +1 maximum stamina.

chips.label: Runner's High
chips.text: The legs just keep going. +2 maximum stamina.

chips.label: Endless Run
chips.text: +2 maximum stamina, and defending gives 1 stamina extra.

chips.label: Snack Time
chips.text: Snacks heal 2 more. It looks like a biscuit, don't ask.

chips.label: Power Nap
chips.text: You recover 3 HP after every fight. Eyes closed, still alert.

chips.label: Phoenix Heart
chips.text: Snack Time and Power Nap in one. Burns bright, comes back.

chips.label: Neat Look
chips.text: Looking sharp helps. Talk and Intimidate take 2 more composure.

chips.label: Cool Smile
chips.text: Harmless face, unsettling eyes. 3 more composure.

chips.label: Boss Aura
chips.text: They fold before you open your mouth. 4 more composure.

chips.label: Cool Head
chips.text: Effects of burning end 1 round sooner.

chips.label: Ice Veins
chips.text: Effects of burning are only half as strong.

chips.label: Frozen Heart
chips.text: Immune to burning.

chips.label: Dry Cuffs
chips.text: Effects of being soaked end 1 round sooner.

chips.label: Dry Heart
chips.text: Effects of being soaked are only half as strong.

chips.label: Desert Soul
chips.text: Immune to being soaked.

chips.label: Rubber Soles
chips.text: Effects of shock end 1 round sooner.

chips.label: Static Guard
chips.text: Effects of shock are only half as strong.

chips.label: Lightning Rod
chips.text: Immune to shock.

chips.label: Thick Skin
chips.text: Effects of bleeding end 1 round sooner.

chips.label: Steel Skin
chips.text: Effects of bleeding are only half as strong.

chips.label: Iron Will
chips.text: Immune to bleeding.

chips.label: Firm Stance
chips.text: Effects of being shaken end 1 round sooner.

chips.label: Iron Stance
chips.text: Effects of being shaken are only half as strong.

chips.label: Rock Stance
chips.text: Immune to being shaken.

chips.label: Clear Eyes
chips.text: Effects of being blinded end 1 round sooner.

chips.label: Sharp Eyes
chips.text: Effects of being blinded are only half as strong.

chips.label: Third Eye
chips.text: Immune to being blinded.

Use case: style-transfer. Build a production icon CONTACT SHEET extending the attached APPROVED Eden Rise tech module icons. Match this reference faithfully: smooth subdued category gradients fading to charcoal, SPARSE fine angular 45/90-degree circuit traces with solid square ends, elegant narrow painted category-coloured symbols, thin warm metal edge with subtle corners, NO smoky organic texture. Low gloss satin. Refined stylized game art, coherent with painterly skill icons but plainly engineered tech. No big solid white symbols. No gems/runes, excessive filigree, holes, perforations, honeycombs, porous textures. No text, numbers, gridlines, labels or captions.
LAYOUT: EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS by THREE ROWS, twelve separate icons on truly transparent alpha, square cells with equal padding. COLUMN identity fixed; SAME four symbols repeated down rows, not twelve different subjects.
ROW1: BRONZE thin frame, exactly THREE round level lights at bottom, LEFT ONE active warm ivory, other TWO visibly dim.
ROW2: SILVER thin frame, exactly THREE round level lights at bottom, LEFT TWO active ivory, last ONE dim.
ROW3: GOLD thin frame, exactly THREE round level lights at bottom, ALL THREE active warm ivory, only very restrained rim glow.
Tier differences apply to frame material and active light count ONLY, not symbol or category colours. Symbols equally slender and readable at64px at every tier. Frame must fit completely within its square cell, separated transparent margins. Do not retain approved reference's 4x2 layout; requested output is 4x3.
COLUMN SPECIFICATIONS left to right:
1 Force: wine-red hammer diamond; 2 Precision: mustard-yellow fine crosshair diamond; 3 Technique: sea-teal outlined cog diamond; 4 Counter: dusty-blue slender return arrow diamond
